retrievalProfile.description: A dark, aggressive horrorcore aesthetic featuring a central hooded figure with a skull mask and a secondary figure in a low-angle crouch, unified by blood-red distressed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, dark-themed composition featuring a large hooded figure wearing a skull mask and carrying a scythe, with a smaller muscular figure in the foreground. The scene is dominated by deep blacks and punctuated by aggressive, blood-red textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large hooded figure as the primary background anchor
Smaller muscular figure as the foreground focal point
Aggressive red title text overlapping both figures to create depth
Circular red glow behind the main figure to separate it from the black background
coreInvariants: Blood-red distressed texture on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large hooded figure occupies the top two-thirds; smaller figure centered at the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white skull mask provides the highest point of contrast and the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the skull mask down to the red title, then to the secondary figure at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space on the left and right sides focuses attention on the central vertical axis.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (skull mask, secondary text, and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blood Red (title text and background glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value white highlights and high-saturation red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to black, white, and deep red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive brush script and wide serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses jagged, dripping, or torn edges to simulate blood or paint
Secondary text uses a clean, wide-spaced serif for contrast
Artist names use a casual, hand-drawn script style
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on the 'N' and 'B' in the title to frame the composition

composition.relationshipToImage: cuts across the midsection of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive textured display type paired with clean, widely-spaced metadata for a professional yet gritty look.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory sticker in bottom left

preserve: Red color of the main title
Wide tracking of the top text
avoid: Centered alignment for the script artist names

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the horror/dripping aesthetic of the main title
Matches the wide, clean serif style of the top metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark urban horror scene with a large hooded figure in a skull mask at the top and a muscular man in chains at the bottom, set against a black background with a subtle red circular glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, blood-red distressed brush-style title across the center. Add a small, wide-spaced white serif font at the very top and hand-drawn white script for artist names near the title.

verificationChecks: Is the title text blood-red and textured?
Is the skull mask the brightest point of the image?
Is the top text widely spaced and all-caps?
Does the scythe frame the upper figure?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the title font
mustRedesign: Avoid using generic sans-serif for the title
Do not use a flat red without texture for the main text

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the two figures
avoid: Poorly integrated text that looks 'stuck on'
Vibrant colors like blue or yellow

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is legible against the dark background
Ensure the parental advisory logo is correctly placed in the corner
Verify the scythe has a metallic sheen
Confirm the skull mask has realistic bone texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast horror subject with centered, distressed red display type and wide-tracked white serif metadata for a consistent horrorcore aesthetic.
